title: The beach outside Belo Sur Mer can be recognized by the somewhat dirty sand and the curved shoreline with the ocean to the northwest.
description: The beach outside Belo Sur Mer can be recognized by the somewhat dirty sand and the curved shoreline with the ocean to the northwest.

title: Another cart dragged by a white cow on the left and a black and white cow on the right can be found just south of Andavadoaka.
description: Another cart dragged by a white cow on the left and a black and white cow on the right can be found just south of Andavadoaka.

title: Coverage with multiple different people walking near and around the trekker, and with a small village to the west, can be found in the southeastern part of the bay.
description: Coverage with multiple different people walking near and around the trekker, and with a small village to the west, can be found in the southeastern part of the bay. Part of the coverage goes through a very shallow body of water.

title: The town of Andavadoaka can be recognized by three different people appearing on the coverage; One wearing a greyish hat and a light blue shirt, and two with red and white…
description: The town of Andavadoaka can be recognized by three different people appearing on the coverage; One wearing a greyish hat and a light blue shirt, and two with red and white T-shirts.

title: A cluster of fishing nets can be found in the bay.
description: A cluster of fishing nets can be found in the bay.

title: A small section of the coverage by the Sambirano river has two different people present on the coverage; one with a red T-shirt and white cap, and one with a spotted dress.
description: A small section of the coverage by the Sambirano river has two different people present on the coverage; one with a red T-shirt and white cap, and one with a spotted dress.

title: The Tsaranoro Massif is a large monolithic mountain with trekker coverage.
description: The Tsaranoro Massif is a large monolithic mountain with trekker coverage. The steep mountainsides, combined with the mountainous area surrounding the coverage makes it very recognizable. The four people following the trekker can also occasionally be a useful clue.

title: A second Trekker, going to the northeast of Andavadoaka can be recognized by a person with a light blue T-shirt.
description: A second Trekker, going to the northeast of Andavadoaka can be recognized by a person with a light blue T-shirt.

title: A small settlement is found in the northeastern end of Tsaranoro.
description: A small settlement is found in the northeastern end of Tsaranoro. The mountains can typically be seen in the background.

title: A small part of the coverage in Tsaranoro was taken inside a forest, which occasionally hides the surrounding mountains.
description: A small part of the coverage in Tsaranoro was taken inside a forest, which occasionally hides the surrounding mountains. The best way to recognize this area is the relatively dark coverage, combined with the four people following the trekker.

title: The trekker next to the RN8 can be recognized by its extreme dryness, combined with the four people wearing red, blue, grey and light blue respectively.
description: The trekker next to the RN8 can be recognized by its extreme dryness, combined with the four people wearing red, blue, grey and light blue respectively.

title: An area with coverage south of Ambiky can be recognized by the large, solitary green bushes combined with a very slight red tinge in the dirt.
description: An area with coverage south of Ambiky can be recognized by the large, solitary green bushes combined with a very slight red tinge in the dirt. Certain parts of the coverage are quite wet.

title: Toliara can be recognized as being a generally quite busy-looking town and the only large town on Madagascar with no person following the trekker.
description: Toliara can be recognized as being a generally quite busy-looking town and the only large town on Madagascar with no person following the trekker.

title: Morondava has a very smooth sand beach, with the ocean to the northwest.
description: Morondava has a very smooth sand beach, with the ocean to the northwest. There are a large number of palms visible.

title: A beach west of Ambiky can be recognized by the low trees combined with low mountains to the northwest.
description: A beach west of Ambiky can be recognized by the low trees combined with low mountains to the northwest.

title: Belo Sur Mer can be recognized by the large number of palms combined with the blanket of white sand on the ground.
description: Belo Sur Mer can be recognized by the large number of palms combined with the blanket of white sand on the ground.

title: A blue cart dragged by a black cow on the left and a brown-white cow on the right can be found south of Andavadoaka.
description: A blue cart dragged by a black cow on the left and a brown-white cow on the right can be found south of Andavadoaka.

title: Baobab Avenue is easy to recognize by the extremely broad trunked baobab trees along the side of the road.
description: Baobab Avenue is easy to recognize by the extremely broad trunked baobab trees along the side of the road.

title: A piece of coverage, partly taken on a large grassy field, and partly on the side of a sand dune, can be found south of Manahy.
description: A piece of coverage, partly taken on a large grassy field, and partly on the side of a sand dune, can be found south of Manahy.

title: The main part of the trekker coverage surrounding Andavadoaka can be recognized by either the person wearing a greyish hat and light blue shirt or a person wearing a yellow…
description: The main part of the trekker coverage surrounding Andavadoaka can be recognized by either the person wearing a greyish hat and light blue shirt or a person wearing a yellow T-shirt.

title: A row boat containing five people with a wide wooden frame surrounding it can be found northwest of Ambohimena.
description: A row boat containing five people with a wide wooden frame surrounding it can be found northwest of Ambohimena.

title: Morondava is most easily recognized by the bald person wearing either a light green or a light red striped shirt.
description: Morondava is most easily recognized by the bald person wearing either a light green or a light red striped shirt. It is also one of few towns where the trekker walks on a paved road.

title: The coverage on the island of Nosy Ambariovato can be recognized by the people, one wearing a blue T-shirt and sunglasses on their forehead, one with a light red T-shirt and one…
description: The coverage on the island of Nosy Ambariovato can be recognized by the people, one wearing a blue T-shirt and sunglasses on their forehead, one with a light red T-shirt and one with a darker red tank top. There is also a fourth person in some of the coverage, wearing a light blue T-shirt. The coverage is very hilly and forested.

title: The second part with the same two people is found to the east of St Augustin, going through a hilly landscape with a lot of shrubs.
description: The second part with the same two people is found to the east of St Augustin, going through a hilly landscape with a lot of shrubs.

title: The coverage in Ambanja can be recognized by a person wearing a dark blue T-shirt and black sunglasses.
description: The coverage in Ambanja can be recognized by a person wearing a dark blue T-shirt and black sunglasses.

title: There are three major sections of coverage along the Sambirano river, most of which can be identified with the single person, wearing a dark blue T-shirt and sunglasses on their…
description: There are three major sections of coverage along the Sambirano river, most of which can be identified with the single person, wearing a dark blue T-shirt and sunglasses on their forehead. The same person is also present on Nosy Ambariovato.

title: Ambiky can be recognized by the large number of palms combined with the brown, sandy dirt road.
description: Ambiky can be recognized by the large number of palms combined with the brown, sandy dirt road. In most of the coverage, there is a person walking in front of the trekker with a grey T-shirt and a brown backpack.

title: Two pieces of coverage can be recognized by two people following the trekker; one with a yellow tank top and one with a blue T-shirt.
description: Two pieces of coverage can be recognized by two people following the trekker; one with a yellow tank top and one with a blue T-shirt. The first of these two parts is located in the town of St Augustin.

title: Coverage on a somewhat rocky ground with no people following the trekker can be found southwest of the bay.
description: Coverage on a somewhat rocky ground with no people following the trekker can be found southwest of the bay.

title: There is a village by the northern shore of Nosy Ambariovato.
description: There is a village by the northern shore of Nosy Ambariovato.

title: A small, very sandy village with the shore to the north can be seen on a small cape north of Andavadoaka.
description: A small, very sandy village with the shore to the north can be seen on a small cape north of Andavadoaka. Part of the coverage was taken just outside the shoreline.

title: A car with a barely visible grey metal roof rack can be seen by Manahy.
description: A car with a barely visible grey metal roof rack can be seen by Manahy. There are some locations where the car is completely blurred out, where the shape of the blur is the best indication of the area.

title: A small seaside village, with little to no visible people can be found in the northern end of the bay, south of Andavadoaka.
description: A small seaside village, with little to no visible people can be found in the northern end of the bay, south of Andavadoaka.

title: While not entirely unique, most streets in Rundu consist of deep and light coloured sand, with a bumpy texture, and tire tracks engraved into it.
description: While not entirely unique, most streets in Rundu consist of deep and light coloured sand, with a bumpy texture, and tire tracks engraved into it.

title: Orange coloured mountains
description: Orange coloured mountains, which are covered in green vegetation surround the partly hilly town of Opuwo, from where you have a great vantage point of the mountains.

title: Otavi sits in between many sets of mountains, all of which are quite far away, but can be seen from the city.
description: Otavi sits in between many sets of mountains, all of which are quite far away, but can be seen from the city. Being a northern town, Otavi is quite green, with slightly reddish sandy soil, which is common for the more northern cities. The entire town is on a northeast to southwest grid, which can rule out similar looking cities like Grootfontein and Tsumeb.

title: The crown-like outline of Mt Brandeburg is barely visible to the northwest from most parts of Uis, while Many other dry hills surround the town.
description: The crown-like outline of Mt Brandeburg is barely visible to the northwest from most parts of Uis, while Many other dry hills surround the town. The open pit mines, which have a distinctive white colour, can be seen from the western half of Uis.

title: From almost anywhere in Karibib the dark silhouette of Erongo Mountain can be seen to the north.
description: From almost anywhere in Karibib the dark silhouette of Erongo Mountain can be seen to the north. Dry hills covered in shrubbery flank the town to the south.

title: A lone tall ridge with a rugged, striated texture lies to the SSE of Usakos.
description: A lone tall ridge with a rugged, striated texture lies to the SSE of Usakos. Another smaller plain textured mountain, which has a red tint to it, is just to the east, or northeast, depending on part of town. From the northern part of town, the cliffy edges of Erongo Mountain are visible to the north.

title: While very similar to Swakopmund and Walvis Bay, Henties Bay is less gridded and noticeably poorer, with most roads being unpaved.
description: While very similar to Swakopmund and Walvis Bay, Henties Bay is less gridded and noticeably poorer, with most roads being unpaved. Unlike in Swakopmund, where yellow lamps are only found near the downtown, here they can occasionally be found throughout the town.

title: Gobabis is a big north-south gridded city in the desert, with red soil permeating the landscape and roads, which are very often unpaved.
description: Gobabis is a big north-south gridded city in the desert, with red soil permeating the landscape and roads, which are very often unpaved. A faint green ridge is sometimes visible to the north to northwest. The street signs, while rare, are also green, with silver framing on the top and bottom. Blue bins are also a good clue for Gobabis.

title: Windhoek is by far the largest city in Namibia, as well as the richest, with many high rise buildings near downtown.
description: Windhoek is by far the largest city in Namibia, as well as the richest, with many high rise buildings near downtown. Affluent and often gated single family houses are a common sight on the sides of hilly streets, which are often well marked with simple white street signs.

title: Langstrand is a small resort town between Swakopmund and Walvis Bay with pink brick sidewalks next to essentially every road.
description: Langstrand is a small resort town between Swakopmund and Walvis Bay with pink brick sidewalks next to essentially every road. The weather is always overcast and gloomy.

title: A boat going up the Sambirano River can be seen with two people; a tourist with a blue T-shirt and a gondolier with a brown shirt.
description: A boat going up the Sambirano River can be seen with two people; a tourist with a blue T-shirt and a gondolier with a brown shirt. The northernmost part of the coverage is very dark, as it was taken during sunset.

title: Four people; one dressed in red, one in blue and one in yellow in the back, and one dressed in brown at the front, can be seen on a boat by the town of St Augustin.
description: Four people; one dressed in red, one in blue and one in yellow in the back, and one dressed in brown at the front, can be seen on a boat by the town of St Augustin.

title: These somewhat baity agricultural fields can be found just west of Mariental.
description: These somewhat baity agricultural fields can be found just west of Mariental.

title: If you see Portuguese text in Eswatini, you are most likely in the small town of Lomahasha.
description: If you see Portuguese text in Eswatini, you are most likely in the small town of Lomahasha.

title: Light coloured rocky hillsides
description: Light coloured rocky hillsides are everywhere in the hilly coastal town of Luderitz.

title: The landscape of Aus is very rocky, with dry hills devoid of vegetation all around.
description: The landscape of Aus is very rocky, with dry hills devoid of vegetation all around. The hills to the north have a fairly smooth sloped shape, while the peaks to the south are more rugged.

title: Rosh Pinah can easily be recognised by the dry mountains just northeast of the city, as well as slightly further away to the southwest.
description: Rosh Pinah can easily be recognised by the dry mountains just northeast of the city, as well as slightly further away to the southwest.

title: Ariamsvlei can be recognised by a single flat-topped hill with rocky ridgelines near the top, and small amounts of green shrubbery dotting the slopes.
description: Ariamsvlei can be recognised by a single flat-topped hill with rocky ridgelines near the top, and small amounts of green shrubbery dotting the slopes. The hill is either to the north, or east, depending on the part of town. The soil has a dark red tint to it, with lots of bushes and small trees growing around the place.

title: Orange coloured thatched fences, walls, and huts are everywhere in the desert town of Aussenkehr, which is built on the slope of a hill.
description: Orange coloured thatched fences, walls, and huts are everywhere in the desert town of Aussenkehr, which is built on the slope of a hill.

title: While not as common, the same thatched architecture is present in Noordoewer, and unlike Aussenkehr, the town was built on flat land, with an imposing cliffside visible to the…
description: While not as common, the same thatched architecture is present in Noordoewer, and unlike Aussenkehr, the town was built on flat land, with an imposing cliffside visible to the southwest, across the border in South Africa. Similar mountains can be seen to the north as well.

title: The coverage on the RN8 between Andriamena and Marofandilia can easily be recognized by the large silver roof rack on the Street View car.
description: The coverage on the RN8 between Andriamena and Marofandilia can easily be recognized by the large silver roof rack on the Street View car. The coverage is very dry and sandy.

title: A mainly blue boat can be found along the coast south of Nosy Ambariovato.
description: A mainly blue boat can be found along the coast south of Nosy Ambariovato.

title: A white boat, containing many people, can be found going around the island of Nosy Ambariovato.
description: A white boat, containing many people, can be found going around the island of Nosy Ambariovato.

title: The boat in the bay south of Andavadoaka can be recognized by either the somewhat smaller sail than the one north of Andavadoaka, or the person sitting by the bow wearing a red…
description: The boat in the bay south of Andavadoaka can be recognized by either the somewhat smaller sail than the one north of Andavadoaka, or the person sitting by the bow wearing a red T-shirt with the text “Diesel”. Beware that only one of the two will appear on most of the coverage.

title: The Tatra Mountains are the highest mountains in Poland.
description: The Tatra Mountains are the highest mountains in Poland. They can be found near Zakopane, on the border with Slovakia.

title: Białystok uses turquoise street signs, with the district marked on the bottom.
description: Białystok uses turquoise street signs, with the district marked on the bottom.

title: Szczecin uses colourful green and blue signs.
description: Szczecin uses colourful green and blue signs. The city district is marked on the bottom.

title: Gdańsk
description: Gdańsk is a large city in northwestern Poland. Its historic downtown features unique buildings that were inspired by Dutch Golden Age architecture. These buildings look somewhat similar to Amsterdam.

title: The main road on the Hel peninsula is very recognizable: it is a coastal forest road with a railway track running parallel to it.
description: The main road on the Hel peninsula is very recognizable: it is a coastal forest road with a railway track running parallel to it.

title: Most of the coverage in Antananarivo was taken on the side of a hill looking out over the city, which leads up to the Queen’s Palace, which can be seen near the top of the hill.
description: Most of the coverage in Antananarivo was taken on the side of a hill looking out over the city, which leads up to the Queen’s Palace, which can be seen near the top of the hill.

title: The section of the N1 road near the border town of Elubo is very new: it has dark and unblemished asphalt, a very crisp-looking middle line, and no outer lines.
description: The section of the N1 road near the border town of Elubo is very new: it has dark and unblemished asphalt, a very crisp-looking middle line, and no outer lines. The vegetation is dense and occasionally features palm trees.

title: The Obudu Plateau road can be recognized by having the tallest mountains in Nigeria with street view coverage.
description: The Obudu Plateau road can be recognized by having the tallest mountains in Nigeria with street view coverage. The road winds up lush, green mountains and the coverage is slightly foggy and wet.

title: Dark red soil
description: Dark red soil is most commonly found in and around Benin City and Enugu.

title: A short section NW of Kamanjab along with the same somewhat green and hilly landscape, features an impressive array of clouds in the sky, with the sun attempting to peek out from…
description: A short section NW of Kamanjab along with the same somewhat green and hilly landscape, features an impressive array of clouds in the sky, with the sun attempting to peek out from the west. Hues of orange can be seen on the horizon.

title: The boat covering some small atolls along the central parts of the west coast can be recognized by the driver, wearing a white cap and no shirt.
description: The boat covering some small atolls along the central parts of the west coast can be recognized by the driver, wearing a white cap and no shirt.

title: The boat north of Andavadoaka can mostly be recognized by the large sail almost filling up the entire screen and the bow which is painted yellow and blue.
description: The boat north of Andavadoaka can mostly be recognized by the large sail almost filling up the entire screen and the bow which is painted yellow and blue. Note that the sail is not present in the northern parts of the coverage.

title: The coastal cities of Swakopmund and Walvis Bay are flat and often have sandy streets, with palms and Norfolk pines planted around.
description: The coastal cities of Swakopmund and Walvis Bay are flat and often have sandy streets, with palms and Norfolk pines planted around. Street and road signs often have square-shaped signposts.

title: You can recognise the Mlawula Nature Reserve thanks to the narrow dirt tracks, tall grass and overall savannah landscape.
description: You can recognise the Mlawula Nature Reserve thanks to the narrow dirt tracks, tall grass and overall savannah landscape.

title: On a section of the A25, just east of the big reservoir, the camera is covered in raindrops in one direction.
description: On a section of the A25, just east of the big reservoir, the camera is covered in raindrops in one direction.

title: The only city with a significantly urbanised downtown area is Maseru, the capital.
description: The only city with a significantly urbanised downtown area is Maseru, the capital. All other towns have a very provincial feel in comparison to Maseru.

title: Qacha's Nek is a very recognizable town that is located far away from most other towns, on the southeastern border with South Africa.
description: Qacha's Nek is a very recognizable town that is located far away from most other towns, on the southeastern border with South Africa.

title: Kirindy Mitea National Park can be most easily recognized by having the reddest soil present on Street View in Madagascar.
description: Kirindy Mitea National Park can be most easily recognized by having the reddest soil present on Street View in Madagascar.

title: The western part of the C34 is a flat, east to west road.
description: The western part of the C34 is a flat, east to west road. There are two long, straight sections with an abundance of sugar cane. Furthermore, you will see a large mountain range north along the entire mentioned stretches of road.

title: Aberdare National Park has a grey and brown car that features a large snorkel.
description: Aberdare National Park has a grey and brown car that features a large snorkel. Almost all of the coverage is outside of the National Park, with only two roads within the park covered. The main road through the park has these rubber bands on the roof rack, which can only be found in one other National Park in Kenya.

title: Nairobi is the largest city in the country, and capital of Kenya.
description: Nairobi is the largest city in the country, and capital of Kenya. It is the only city to have a considerable amount of skyscrapers, and is highly developed. It is densely populated, and is surrounded by small, poor settlements.

title: The city of Wajir often has blinding white dirt roads, combined with extremely red soil on the roadside.
description: The city of Wajir often has blinding white dirt roads, combined with extremely red soil on the roadside.

title: In a lot of the coverage north of Mt Kilimanjaro, the mountain is visible to the south, usually obscured by clouds.
description: In a lot of the coverage north of Mt Kilimanjaro, the mountain is visible to the south, usually obscured by clouds. In the city of Oloitoktok, the mountain will often be visible directly to the south.

title: The area surrounding and between Kerio and Lodwar uses the same car as the Aberdare National Park, but with a vastly different landscape.
description: The area surrounding and between Kerio and Lodwar uses the same car as the Aberdare National Park, but with a vastly different landscape. It is very sandy, dry, and has little vegetation.

title: North of Marsabit will be much flatter, with some mountains in the distance.
description: North of Marsabit will be much flatter, with some mountains in the distance. The stretch just north or Marsabit will have mountains visible to the south, while further north, a different range can be seen. It will also have much less vegetation.

title: The Boabeng Fiema Monkey Sanctuary has a unique Google car.
description: The Boabeng Fiema Monkey Sanctuary has a unique Google car. The ‘Ghana tape’ and roof rack will not be visible however, the black right side mirror will be slightly visible just outside the blur.

title: East of the intersection with the C35, the road has a constant SW to NW angle, and grainy pavement.
description: East of the intersection with the C35, the road has a constant SW to NW angle, and grainy pavement. The grass looks soft to the touch, and the somewhat sandy soil is typical of this region. Cumulus clouds dot the sky.

title: A couple of atolls on the central west coast can be seen on Street View.
description: A couple of atolls on the central west coast can be seen on Street View. The northernmost is the smallest, and is easily recognizable as it only consists of sand and you can always see from one shore to the other.

title: A large rugged mountain formation can be seen to the west from the paved C13.
description: A large rugged mountain formation can be seen to the west from the paved C13. Other smaller hills and mountains can be seen in other directions. Light coloured soil hugs the road, while more orange coloured soil can be seen further from the road, with light green vegetation and shrubbery acting as a contrast.

title: East of Karibib, the weather becomes completely clear, and the mountains are only visible further in the distance.
description: East of Karibib, the weather becomes completely clear, and the mountains are only visible further in the distance. The wide shoulder lines combined with the E-NE road angle makes this section distinct.

title: A bit further east, between Karibib and Usakos, you’ll find sunrise coverage combined with a sky covered in fairly thin clouds.
description: A bit further east, between Karibib and Usakos, you’ll find sunrise coverage combined with a sky covered in fairly thin clouds. There are mountains to the north, as well as smaller hills just south of the road, while it's mostly flat to the E-NE.

title: Upon closer inspection of signs, billboards and posters, you will notice that the county name is often written.
description: Upon closer inspection of signs, billboards and posters, you will notice that the county name is often written. Therefore, knowledge of Kenyan counties can be extremely useful in region guessing.

title: The MR3 South of Ngomane can be recognized thanks to flatness, long dry grass and the dirt on the camera.
description: The MR3 South of Ngomane can be recognized thanks to flatness, long dry grass and the dirt on the camera.

title: After the road climbs onto the plateau east of Kuibis, the landscape will seem mostly flat until you reach the intersection with the D432, but you can notice the road having a…
description: After the road climbs onto the plateau east of Kuibis, the landscape will seem mostly flat until you reach the intersection with the D432, but you can notice the road having a gradual incline for long stretches. The soil around is very red in colour, with limited shrubbery or signs of life. The weather is clear, with some clouds far in the distance.

title: There are two large man-made water reservoirs in the mountainous part of Lesotho, which can be seen from several road sections.
description: There are two large man-made water reservoirs in the mountainous part of Lesotho, which can be seen from several road sections.

title: Several sections of the A5 south of Nyakosoba are under construction.
description: Several sections of the A5 south of Nyakosoba are under construction. As a result, you will often see a sort of temporary “bollard” next to the road, consisting of a stick that is mostly painted white.

title: The road going from Ramatsediso to Sehlabathebe NP, in the southeast on the border with South Africa, is very recognizable.
description: The road going from Ramatsediso to Sehlabathebe NP, in the southeast on the border with South Africa, is very recognizable. Consider guessing there if the following three things are all true for your location:

title: The other atolls can be recognized by their small size relative to other landmasses and the broad leaved palms which is rarely found anywhere else in the country.
description: The other atolls can be recognized by their small size relative to other landmasses and the broad leaved palms which is rarely found anywhere else in the country.

title: The Ankasa Game Reserve has a unique Google car.
description: The Ankasa Game Reserve has a unique Google car. The entire front of the Google car can be seen, with only the actual camera blurred. The roof of the car will have a street view vinyl and the ‘Ghana tape’ will be present.

title: A flat landscape with coastal vegetation and many palms can be seen east of Lekki.
description: A flat landscape with coastal vegetation and many palms can be seen east of Lekki. The ground is very sandy. Almost all of the coverage is old Generation 3, with a silver follow car.

title: The road between Nkwanta and Domanko is unpaved, with a powerline close to the road to your east or northeast.
description: The road between Nkwanta and Domanko is unpaved, with a powerline close to the road to your east or northeast. The road itself runs in a general SE-NW direction, through a lush savannah landscape that is typical of central Ghana.

title: The Salaga-Tamale road up to Kpalbusi is a dirt road with very moody overcast coverage.
description: The Salaga-Tamale road up to Kpalbusi is a dirt road with very moody overcast coverage. The soil tends to be very dark, with a purple or brown tinge to it. The road also has a unique tropical savannah feel. The soil is most dark near the town of Salaga.

title: The A3 going east of Potiskum to the Borno State border can be recognized by the Generation 4 coverage, mostly open arid landscape, and the highway being divided.
description: The A3 going east of Potiskum to the Borno State border can be recognized by the Generation 4 coverage, mostly open arid landscape, and the highway being divided.

title: The C40 has a general NW angle going through flat terrain with the usual northern landscape of short grass next to the road, trees further away and some hills further in the…
description: The C40 has a general NW angle going through flat terrain with the usual northern landscape of short grass next to the road, trees further away and some hills further in the distance. Similar to the C39, a lot of cumulus clouds dot the sky, and the closer to Kamanjab you get, the lower the sun sets to the west.

title: The C38 is yet another indistinct paved northern road with sandy soil, somewhat green vegetation and short grass lining the road.
description: The C38 is yet another indistinct paved northern road with sandy soil, somewhat green vegetation and short grass lining the road. The sky, which is covered with a spotty blanket of clouds, is generally the most distinct clue. The sun is faintly shining through the clouds to the north.

title: Most of the C39 travels through a wide valley, with small vegetation-covered hills on both sides, which are mostly visible to the north.
description: Most of the C39 travels through a wide valley, with small vegetation-covered hills on both sides, which are mostly visible to the north. The N-NE angle and puffy cumulus clouds dotting the sunny sky are also noteworthy.

title: Road A1 between Windhoek and Okahandja, featuring a savannah-like landscape, is just one of two major roads that are divided in Namibia.
description: Road A1 between Windhoek and Okahandja, featuring a savannah-like landscape, is just one of two major roads that are divided in Namibia. The other one can be found just southeast of Swakopmund, and features a dry coastal landscape, with light sandy soil and sand dunes.

title: Very red soil and small tufts of golden grass lining the road can be used to recognise the paved C19.
description: Very red soil and small tufts of golden grass lining the road can be used to recognise the paved C19. The sky is mostly covered in dark clouds, especially to the north.

title: This distinct region in the central South of the country, mostly along the MR9, can be recognized by the dark, overwhelming greenness and tall wooded mountains.
description: This distinct region in the central South of the country, mostly along the MR9, can be recognized by the dark, overwhelming greenness and tall wooded mountains.

title: Vineyards are exclusively found around Aussenkehr on the South African border in the south.
description: Vineyards are exclusively found around Aussenkehr on the South African border in the south.

title: Homa Bay has this protruding hill to the east that is often visible.
description: Homa Bay has this protruding hill to the east that is often visible.

title: Between Kitale and Mt Elgon, you can find the Aberdare car as well, but it will always have rubber bands, unlike in Aberdare where it will only have them on the main roads through…
description: Between Kitale and Mt Elgon, you can find the Aberdare car as well, but it will always have rubber bands, unlike in Aberdare where it will only have them on the main roads through the park. It can be differentiated from Aberdare by its redder dirt, and greener landscape.

title: Mara Triangle has no considerable mountains and most of it is either flat or hilly.
description: Mara Triangle has no considerable mountains and most of it is either flat or hilly. It has a white car that can be found in other Kenyan National Parks. Generation 4 coverage exists there as well.

title: Amboseli National Park has a grey car with a small snorkel.
description: Amboseli National Park has a grey car with a small snorkel. It is very flat with tan grass, few trees, and dried up lake beds. You can always see the base of Kilimanjaro to the south, with most of it obscured by clouds.

title: This stretch of the B8 just north of Kibaoni has many succulents on the side of the road.
description: This stretch of the B8 just north of Kibaoni has many succulents on the side of the road.

title: White flowers
description: White flowers, especially when they are in large numbers, are commonly found east of Chyulu Hills National Park, as well as in Tsavo National Park and near the A109 south of Nairobi.

title: A few roads in the north lack the typical outer yellows.
description: A few roads in the north lack the typical outer yellows.

title: These distinctive silos are found in Pandamatenga in northeastern Botswana and can be seen all around the town.
description: These distinctive silos are found in Pandamatenga in northeastern Botswana and can be seen all around the town.

title: Sugar cane
description: Sugar cane is grown in several areas along the Eastern border.

title: This desolate paved road goes in a general E-SE direction through a fairly flat and dry landscape.
description: This desolate paved road goes in a general E-SE direction through a fairly flat and dry landscape. Small clouds dot the sky. The shrubbery is quite green for the most part, especially in the east, which is also very hilly.

title: The B4 east of Luderitz has almost blindingly bright sandy soil.
description: The B4 east of Luderitz has almost blindingly bright sandy soil. The landscape close to the road is generally flat, with hills and mountains in the distance. Close to Luderitz the landscape becomes much hillier. A railway follows the road closely on the south side for most of this section.

title: Between Seeheim and Keetmanshoop, the landscape close to the road is flat, with mountains always close by.
description: Between Seeheim and Keetmanshoop, the landscape close to the road is flat, with mountains always close by. Just east of Seeheim, you’ll see a short ridge to the NE, with a lone mountain just west of it, as well as a long ridge far away to the west. A bit east, on the NE-bound stretch, mountains are in all directions, but you’ll see a long uneven tabletop ridge to the west. A railroad can also be seen to the south on this stretch.

title: The MR8 in Southeastern Eswatini straddling the South African border is recognisable because of this distinct ridge to the east.
description: The MR8 in Southeastern Eswatini straddling the South African border is recognisable because of this distinct ridge to the east.

title: The coastal area just east of Accra, especially on the N1, has a distinct landscape: it is very flat and wide open, with significantly less vegetation than the rest of southern…
description: The coastal area just east of Accra, especially on the N1, has a distinct landscape: it is very flat and wide open, with significantly less vegetation than the rest of southern Ghana. Some parts can look somewhat dry.

title: On a section of the N2 east of Lake Volta, you can often see a ridgeline to your southeast, somewhat close to the road.
description: On a section of the N2 east of Lake Volta, you can often see a ridgeline to your southeast, somewhat close to the road. The road itself also has a distinct angle, running in a general SW-NE direction. The sky is very overcast and grey.

title: The D3600 and the unlabelled road going NE to Mpungu, have a very light coloured, sometimes grainy pavement, with at times very faded yellow lines, which are hard to even see.
description: The D3600 and the unlabelled road going NE to Mpungu, have a very light coloured, sometimes grainy pavement, with at times very faded yellow lines, which are hard to even see. Combined with the either exactly N to S or NE angle, as well as the northern landscape, make this road very distinct.

title: In Francistown, you can often see a lone hill with radio antennas, which is located on the north side of the city.
description: In Francistown, you can often see a lone hill with radio antennas, which is located on the north side of the city. This hill is a good way to distinguish Francistown from Gaborone.

title: Along the C43 you can find some of the most impressive red-coloured tabletop mountains.
description: Along the C43 you can find some of the most impressive red-coloured tabletop mountains. The road is wide and unpaved with light coloured gravel contrasting the otherwise red landscape.

title: The C47 is an even wider unpaved road, with slightly redder soil when compared to the C44.
description: The C47 is an even wider unpaved road, with slightly redder soil when compared to the C44. The road angle on this road is NE bound, with a SW driving direction. You can also look for either a clear sky, or wispy clouds.

title: A very rugged mountain formation can be seen to the west from a few sections of the C35 and its sideroads.
description: A very rugged mountain formation can be seen to the west from a few sections of the C35 and its sideroads.

title: You can recognise the B2 NE of Swakopmund by the sandy soil, and the mountain ridge visible to the east.
description: You can recognise the B2 NE of Swakopmund by the sandy soil, and the mountain ridge visible to the east. A few lone mountains or hills can be seen to the NW as well. Beware that close to Swakopmund the sky is hazy, and you’ll not see the ridge. On this stretch, the coastal looking sandy soil and the NE bound road angle is still generally sufficient to confirm the road.

title: Maun is the only relatively large city in Botswana that has this bright white sandy soil, which is typical for the middle western region of the country.
description: Maun is the only relatively large city in Botswana that has this bright white sandy soil, which is typical for the middle western region of the country.

title: Street signs in Poznań are mainly black, with the district being marked on the blue section at the bottom.
description: Street signs in Poznań are mainly black, with the district being marked on the blue section at the bottom.

title: You can recognise this region in the east of the country thanks to the unusual flatness and the mountains often visible in the distance.
description: You can recognise this region in the east of the country thanks to the unusual flatness and the mountains often visible in the distance.

title: The MR3 from Manzini to the South African border is divided by metal and stone guardrails, making it recognisable.
description: The MR3 from Manzini to the South African border is divided by metal and stone guardrails, making it recognisable.

title: Oranjemund is a well-off gridded city with almost exactly east to west streets, with an abundance of planted vegetation all around the city.
description: Oranjemund is a well-off gridded city with almost exactly east to west streets, with an abundance of planted vegetation all around the city. Multiple Norfolk pines can be seen almost everywhere. Streets are well organised with E-W avenues and N-S streets, which can be seen written on small blue markers next to the gates or on street signs, which have varying designs.

title: Gaborone is the capital and largest city.
description: Gaborone is the capital and largest city. It tends to look richer and more developed than the rest of Botswana, though some neighbourhoods may still look impoverished. In some southern parts of the city hills can be seen, but most of the town is flat.

title: North of Okahandja, the B1 follows a general northbound direction, with the sun shining brightly to the N-NW.
description: North of Okahandja, the B1 follows a general northbound direction, with the sun shining brightly to the N-NW. The sky is otherwise clear of clouds. As for the landscape, it’s flatter than around Windhoek, with only the occasional hill or mountain, otherwise the short golden grass, somewhat green acacia trees and shrubbery further away from the road is typical for middle to north Namibia.

title: Road B6 goes in a general eastwards direction from Windhoek, with the landscape ranging from hilly close to Windhoek, to mostly flat closer to Gobabis.
description: Road B6 goes in a general eastwards direction from Windhoek, with the landscape ranging from hilly close to Windhoek, to mostly flat closer to Gobabis. The soil is somewhat orange in colour, with short green grass and otherwise green vegetation growing from it. The cloud cover also varies, but no part of this road has a clear sky.

title: A village with the shore to the east can be found north of Andavadoaka.
description: A village with the shore to the east can be found north of Andavadoaka.

title: The A121 can be recognized by the lush, tropical vegetation surrounding the divided highway, with a short, concrete median.
description: The A121 can be recognized by the lush, tropical vegetation surrounding the divided highway, with a short, concrete median. Being a major highway, many vehicles, especially trucks, can be seen along it.

title: The southeastern region near Gaborone has many semi-arid hills covered in short shrubs.
description: The southeastern region near Gaborone has many semi-arid hills covered in short shrubs. If you see a lot of these, you are likely to be in the area between Gaborone and Lobatse.

title: Between Gibeon and Tses, the road has wider shoulders, and the pavement quality in general is excellent.
description: Between Gibeon and Tses, the road has wider shoulders, and the pavement quality in general is excellent.

title: Pine tree plantations
description: Pine tree plantations are found in select areas in the West of the country.

title: These light color bricks with excessive amounts of mortar are found along the coast.
description: These light color bricks with excessive amounts of mortar are found along the coast. Walls made of these bricks are commonly seen in this area.

title: The A3 north of Garissa is very unique, with light coloured soil and many green trees on either side of the road.
description: The A3 north of Garissa is very unique, with light coloured soil and many green trees on either side of the road.

title: The B9 in the Northeast is entirely unpaved and has bright reddish orange dirt with many trees surrounding the road.
description: The B9 in the Northeast is entirely unpaved and has bright reddish orange dirt with many trees surrounding the road. Most of it is very flat, but the coverage at the western end of the road can have hills and mountains. The soil also transitions into a more sandy colour.

title: The section of the A2 between Maseru and Mafeteng has by far the best road quality in all of Lesotho.
description: The section of the A2 between Maseru and Mafeteng has by far the best road quality in all of Lesotho.

title: The road connecting the town of Sawla with the N10 has very crisp, new road lines.
description: The road connecting the town of Sawla with the N10 has very crisp, new road lines. Most of the road runs in a general east-west direction, through a lush savannah landscape. The middle line can be solid or dashed.

title: Most unpaved roads in a dry savannah landscape are found north of Wa, as well as near the town itself.
description: Most unpaved roads in a dry savannah landscape are found north of Wa, as well as near the town itself.

title: The A2 between Isiolo and Marsabit has many plants alongside the road and you will often see large mountains in the distance.
description: The A2 between Isiolo and Marsabit has many plants alongside the road and you will often see large mountains in the distance. The stretch going through Namunyak Wildlife Conservation Trust will have a very large mountain range to the west.

title: Red tinted and slightly grainy pavement along with the green savannah-like grassy landscape crowned with low-lying cumulus clouds can be used to recognise the northern section of…
description: Red tinted and slightly grainy pavement along with the green savannah-like grassy landscape crowned with low-lying cumulus clouds can be used to recognise the northern section of road C35.

title: You can recognise this long stretch of B8 by the light coloured grainy pavement as well as the general E-NE angle and vegetated northern landscape.
description: You can recognise this long stretch of B8 by the light coloured grainy pavement as well as the general E-NE angle and vegetated northern landscape.

title: South of the C41 intersection, the road loses its red pavement, and the quality worsens.
description: South of the C41 intersection, the road loses its red pavement, and the quality worsens. The landscape is less grassy, and more sandy, with hills to the west, though often hidden behind the vegetation. The road generally goes in a S-SE direction. Further south, it gets hillier, and parts will have a more SE bound angle. The sky is consistently covered by scattered cirrostratus and cumulus clouds.

title: The mostly unpaved road north of Maun to Khwai can be identified by extremely white sandy soil and tall green trees surrounding the road.
description: The mostly unpaved road north of Maun to Khwai can be identified by extremely white sandy soil and tall green trees surrounding the road. The first section of the road, between Maun and Shorobe, is paved. But that section can still be identified by the trees, faint road markings, and power lines to the west of the road.

title: The C22 is a paved road generally going east, with freshly cut, orange tufts of grass along the road.
description: The C22 is a paved road generally going east, with freshly cut, orange tufts of grass along the road. A couple of large, rocky hills almost hug the road near the middle. The blinding sun low on the horizon to the east can also be helpful.

title: The C34 looks like darker streaks of black sand surrounded by more sand as far as the eye can see.
description: The C34 looks like darker streaks of black sand surrounded by more sand as far as the eye can see. Some coastal shrubbery, and even the coast can be seen in some parts. Unique white bollards with two yellow reflectors on the front, and one red in the back can also be seen along the road at regular intervals.

title: Around Rehoboth the landscape gradually becomes more vegetated, and as you get closer to Windhoek, the hills become more prominent, with a lot of somewhat pointed lonestanding…
description: Around Rehoboth the landscape gradually becomes more vegetated, and as you get closer to Windhoek, the hills become more prominent, with a lot of somewhat pointed lonestanding hills, as well as ridges being visible. The weather is fairly clear with small clouds across the sky.

title: Tall pink sand dunes are mainly found just east of Sossusvlei, and can also be seen from further away on a few roads.
description: Tall pink sand dunes are mainly found just east of Sossusvlei, and can also be seen from further away on a few roads.

title: East of Aus, the road winds through some table-topped mountains, with the railway still just to the south.
description: East of Aus, the road winds through some table-topped mountains, with the railway still just to the south. A similar landscape can briefly be found further east on the road, just east of the intersection with the D432, however the mountains are bigger, closer to the road and redder in colour.

title: Bright soil, clear skies with cloud cover to the east over a tabletop mountain ridge makes this paved N-NW bound road distinct.
description: Bright soil, clear skies with cloud cover to the east over a tabletop mountain ridge makes this paved N-NW bound road distinct.

title: Coastal Kenya can be identified by the presence of coconut palms, with rare areas in Taita-Taveta County also containing them.
description: Coastal Kenya can be identified by the presence of coconut palms, with rare areas in Taita-Taveta County also containing them.

title: The A33 is characterised by a landscape that is more lush than usual.
description: The A33 is characterised by a landscape that is more lush than usual. Trees have lots of green leaves and the grass is very tall. The more north you go, the more lush the vegetation becomes.

title: The A35 is a very recognisable road: there is always a power line to your west.
description: The A35 is a very recognisable road: there is always a power line to your west. It can also be recognised by its grainy asphalt with faded markings. Many small tracks can be found parallel to the road, disappearing into the bushes.

title: Outer yellow road lines are missing on the following sections of the B1:
description: Outer yellow road lines are missing on the following sections of the B1:

title: Montane grasslands with long golden grass and a mountainous landscape are typical of Western Eswatini.
description: Montane grasslands with long golden grass and a mountainous landscape are typical of Western Eswatini.

title: The section of road B1 between Mariental and Rehoboth can be recognised by a combination of the generic arid steppe landscape, the paved road, and mainly the distinct NW bound…
description: The section of road B1 between Mariental and Rehoboth can be recognised by a combination of the generic arid steppe landscape, the paved road, and mainly the distinct NW bound road angle. It can also help to know that the sun is in the SE for this section.

title: Tall palm trees
description: Tall palm trees are commonly found along the coast. Most of them are located in the west.

title: Southeast of Tshabong, the A20 has been recently repainted and has very bright yellow lines and relatively dark asphalt.
description: Southeast of Tshabong, the A20 has been recently repainted and has very bright yellow lines and relatively dark asphalt. There is a powerline running alongside it to the northeast, it has orange-tan sandy soil, and you can often find patches of yellow flowers.

title: The C14 bears resemblance to the previous road, except this road is unpaved, and the skies are covered in a blanket of clouds, especially in the northern half.
description: The C14 bears resemblance to the previous road, except this road is unpaved, and the skies are covered in a blanket of clouds, especially in the northern half. Near the southern end, the sky becomes clear.

title: These monolithic mountains with exposed, weathered rock are common in and around Abuja.
description: These monolithic mountains with exposed, weathered rock are common in and around Abuja.

title: Chobe Flood Plains National Park in the far north has a lot of small, winding dirt road coverage, with a lot of it being just south of the Chobe River.
description: Chobe Flood Plains National Park in the far north has a lot of small, winding dirt road coverage, with a lot of it being just south of the Chobe River. It has scattered lush bushes on either side, and you will often find wildlife such as elephants and warthogs.

title: The Tsodilo Hills World Heritage Site is memorable due to its large protruding hills with exposed rock faces.
description: The Tsodilo Hills World Heritage Site is memorable due to its large protruding hills with exposed rock faces. The coverage around the hills is entirely on dirt roads.

title: Stick fences which seem to go on forever are common in the area around Narok.
description: Stick fences which seem to go on forever are common in the area around Narok.

title: Around Windhoek, you’ll find a small region with a somewhat dry rolling hills landscape, with hills that are covered in dry yellow grass and dead-looking bushes and small trees.
description: Around Windhoek, you’ll find a small region with a somewhat dry rolling hills landscape, with hills that are covered in dry yellow grass and dead-looking bushes and small trees.

title: The highways that run through the northwestern states of Kebbi, Sokoto, Zamfara, and Katsina can be recognized by an even more open and arid landscape compared to Niger state.
description: The highways that run through the northwestern states of Kebbi, Sokoto, Zamfara, and Katsina can be recognized by an even more open and arid landscape compared to Niger state. The tree coverage becomes even more sparse, or there may not be trees at all. These states are entirely covered by shitcam.

title: This pocket south of Tsumeb features the most lush coverage in Namibia, with the grass and mountains being completely green in colour.
description: This pocket south of Tsumeb features the most lush coverage in Namibia, with the grass and mountains being completely green in colour.

title: The northwest part of the country has very limited coverage, most of which is on the A1 or in Sibiloi National Park.
description: The northwest part of the country has very limited coverage, most of which is on the A1 or in Sibiloi National Park. It has faintly tan soil and sparse low trees. A lot of the coverage in this area is very flat, but you can also see hills or mountains.

title: Salt pans
description: Salt pans can be found in central-eastern Botswana. Dirt road coverage can be found leading to the pans and has similar soil and grass, but you can also find many trees along the road. They are mainly found around the Nwetwe pan. The salt pans show up as lakes on the map.

title: The western part of the A2 has overcast coverage, making it recognisable.
description: The western part of the A2 has overcast coverage, making it recognisable.

title: Just outside Gaborone, there is a lot of coverage along very rural, small dirt tracks.
description: Just outside Gaborone, there is a lot of coverage along very rural, small dirt tracks. They can be identified by the orange-red shade of dirt and abundance of green trees and bushes surrounding the road.

title: The C44 is a wide unpaved sandy road lined with trees, easily recognised from the general E-SE angle, and the westbound driving direction.
description: The C44 is a wide unpaved sandy road lined with trees, easily recognised from the general E-SE angle, and the westbound driving direction.

title: Road B1 south of Grunau is a desolate paved road going generally N-NE through a desert landscape with only very low and dry vegetation.
description: Road B1 south of Grunau is a desolate paved road going generally N-NE through a desert landscape with only very low and dry vegetation.

title: Often fairly poor quality pavement with only white road lines, no road lines at all, or just slightly faded road lines and red tinted pavement, are all good clues for the C49 in…
description: Often fairly poor quality pavement with only white road lines, no road lines at all, or just slightly faded road lines and red tinted pavement, are all good clues for the C49 in the panhandle. Near the western end, the sun is very low in the sky, and the weather is fully clear.

title: The road that runs along Botswana’s southern border, through the town of Middlepits, has asphalt with a distinct red tint.
description: The road that runs along Botswana’s southern border, through the town of Middlepits, has asphalt with a distinct red tint. The landscape is arid. In some sections, slight hills can be seen.

title: Tall mountain ranges
description: Tall mountain ranges in Ghana are typically seen near Lake Volta in the highlighted area.

title: This portion of the A30 has a distinct autumn feel unique to it.
description: This portion of the A30 has a distinct autumn feel unique to it. Notably, there are trees with orange coloured leaves lining the road in straight rows. In addition, there is often tall grass as opposed to other autumn looking locations.

title: The area around Kitui is semi-arid, usually mountainous, and has light orange, sandy dirt.
description: The area around Kitui is semi-arid, usually mountainous, and has light orange, sandy dirt.

title: Houses that are made of mud and sticks are commonly seen around the western part of the country and the coast.
description: Houses that are made of mud and sticks are commonly seen around the western part of the country and the coast.

title: Poles in Eswatini are made of dark brown wood and follow a simple design.
description: Poles in Eswatini are made of dark brown wood and follow a simple design. The insulators are mostly mounted on the side.

title: Roads starting with the letters “MR” are exclusive to Eswatini.
description: Roads starting with the letters “MR” are exclusive to Eswatini.

title: All of Eswatini was covered by a white Google car without an antenna.
description: All of Eswatini was covered by a white Google car without an antenna.

title: Eswatini typically uses yellow outside lines and occasionally, triple white middle lines.
description: Eswatini typically uses yellow outside lines and occasionally, triple white middle lines.

title: Licence plates in Eswatini are long and green at the bottom.
description: Licence plates in Eswatini are long and green at the bottom.

title: Concrete bus shelters
description: Concrete bus shelters are a common sight on roads in Eswatini.

title: Eswatini’s landscape is known for its green, wooded hills and tall golden grass.
description: Eswatini’s landscape is known for its green, wooded hills and tall golden grass.

title: Orchards
description: Orchards are mostly concentrated around the towns of Grójec and Sandomierz in southeastern Poland.

title: If you find yourself in an arid, but green, agricultural landscape with an abundance of corn around, you are likely to be in Kano state.
description: If you find yourself in an arid, but green, agricultural landscape with an abundance of corn around, you are likely to be in Kano state. It is only covered by shitcam, without any Generation 3 or 4.

title: The far west areas of the country that are northwest and southwest of Kisumu are the most agricultural parts of the country.
description: The far west areas of the country that are northwest and southwest of Kisumu are the most agricultural parts of the country. You will often see farms, grassy hills, and tall eucalyptus trees in this region of the country.

title: The A20 has mostly clean, recent asphalt.
description: The A20 has mostly clean, recent asphalt. Some sections of the road are much thinner than usual. The landscape is characterised by red soil, dry grey-coloured trees, and very little grass.

title: The southeast part of Namibia has countless small ridges that are NW to SE in orientation.
description: The southeast part of Namibia has countless small ridges that are NW to SE in orientation. Roads ‘riding’ these red sandy ridges appear bumpy, almost like a rollercoaster. Roads winding between the ridges make them appear like miniature valleys.

title: A large region in the middle western part of the country is characterised by very white sandy soil.
description: A large region in the middle western part of the country is characterised by very white sandy soil. In addition, the vegetation tends to look very dry.

title: A pocket around Oshakati, and to a lesser extent the rest of the north features more agricultural land and has very light sandy soil.
description: A pocket around Oshakati, and to a lesser extent the rest of the north features more agricultural land and has very light sandy soil. This map also closely lines up with where you can find the Hyphaene Petersiana fan palms.

title: The landscape in the eastern pocket north of Francistown is characterised by red soil and a somewhat arid look.
description: The landscape in the eastern pocket north of Francistown is characterised by red soil and a somewhat arid look. The soil in these two areas often looks firm and rocky, rather than sandy or dusty. Trees and bushes with yellowed leaves and other “autumn” colours are common. Many trees are bare and withered. You might see fallen leaves on the ground here and there.

title: A coastal sandy landscape with the occasional sand dunes can be found around and north of Swakopmund, as well as two small pockets around Luderitz and Oranjemund further south.
description: A coastal sandy landscape with the occasional sand dunes can be found around and north of Swakopmund, as well as two small pockets around Luderitz and Oranjemund further south.

title: Benue state can be recognized by the lush, green grass covered ground, with reddish soil.
description: Benue state can be recognized by the lush, green grass covered ground, with reddish soil. The vegetation is somewhat scattered, with the grass making way for taller trees. Shorter trees and shrubs between the grass and taller trees are somewhat uncommon. Thatched huts are also common in comparison to other southern states.

title: Some roads have unique triple middle lines, consisting of two solid lines with a dashed line in between.
description: Some roads have unique triple middle lines, consisting of two solid lines with a dashed line in between.

title: Lesotho is a very rural society.
description: Lesotho is a very rural society. You will often see a lot of free-roaming livestock on Lesotho’s roads: most commonly cows, but also horses, donkeys, and other farm animals.

title: Lesotho uses long white licence plates with blue text.
description: Lesotho uses long white licence plates with blue text. If partially unblurred, you may see the Mokorotlo hat symbol on the left.

title: Grasslands in Lesotho primarily consist of short grass.
description: Grasslands in Lesotho primarily consist of short grass.

title: All coverage in Lesotho is Generation 3.
description: All coverage in Lesotho is Generation 3. In almost all locations, the back of a white Google car without an antenna is visible.

title: Many people in Lesotho wear traditional clothing.
description: Many people in Lesotho wear traditional clothing. Most recognizably, a lot of people can be seen wearing a Basotho woollen blanket.

title: Lesotho uses yellow outer lines and white inner lines.
description: Lesotho uses yellow outer lines and white inner lines.

title: One of the best ways to identify the country are the characteristic ‘Lesotho mountains’.
description: One of the best ways to identify the country are the characteristic ‘Lesotho mountains’. They are bare and treeless, often have tabletop-like shapes, and recognizable horizontal rocky ridgelines.

title: In rural areas, you will often see traditional round huts with thatched roofs.
description: In rural areas, you will often see traditional round huts with thatched roofs.

title: These agave plants are common throughout the countryside and often a good clue for the country.
description: These agave plants are common throughout the countryside and often a good clue for the country.

title: Like the four other Southern African countries, Lesotho drives on the left.
description: Like the four other Southern African countries, Lesotho drives on the left.

title: These haystacks are extremely common and are almost exclusively found in Kaduna state.
description: These haystacks are extremely common and are almost exclusively found in Kaduna state.

title: Traditional wooden houses are commonly found in the east, mainly in Podlaskie Voivodeship.
description: Traditional wooden houses are commonly found in the east, mainly in Podlaskie Voivodeship.

title: Conversely, in the mountainous part, the road will usually be directly on the side of the mountain, instead of slightly away from it.
description: Conversely, in the mountainous part, the road will usually be directly on the side of the mountain, instead of slightly away from it. The mountains are often large, closer to the road, and covered in green grass.

title: A savannah landscape combined with rocky hills can most commonly be seen in the northeast in the states of Plateau, Bauchi, Gombe, Adamawa, and the north of Taraba.
description: A savannah landscape combined with rocky hills can most commonly be seen in the northeast in the states of Plateau, Bauchi, Gombe, Adamawa, and the north of Taraba. The hills in the far east and west of this region are typically greener and covered in more vegetation compared to the hills toward the middle of the range.

title: Markings with a white background are most commonly found in Podlaskie voivodeship, and can occasionally be seen in Łódź voivodeship and elsewhere.
description: Markings with a white background are most commonly found in Podlaskie voivodeship, and can occasionally be seen in Łódź voivodeship and elsewhere.

title: Red brick architecture
description: Red brick architecture is common in the western part of the country and a large area east of Nairobi.

title: The landscape east of Windhoek closely resembles that of Botswana, with a generally flat and dry landscape, featuring slightly reddish soil, short golden grass and shrubbery, as…
description: The landscape east of Windhoek closely resembles that of Botswana, with a generally flat and dry landscape, featuring slightly reddish soil, short golden grass and shrubbery, as well as acacia trees.

title: Most of Botswana is as flat as a pancake.
description: Most of Botswana is as flat as a pancake. However, every now and then you will find some elevation. If you see hills, you are most likely in one of the two areas indicated on the minimap.

title: Even though most of Poland is flat, the southern border area is very hilly.
description: Even though most of Poland is flat, the southern border area is very hilly. Some parts even have mountains.

title: Niger state is the shitcam equivalent to Benue state.
description: Niger state is the shitcam equivalent to Benue state. It is almost entirely covered by shitcam, and can be recognized by the scattered trees, reddish soil, and dry grass.

title: Further northwest, you’ll find a somewhat greener region, where the mountains and hills will be covered in shrubbery and trees.
description: Further northwest, you’ll find a somewhat greener region, where the mountains and hills will be covered in shrubbery and trees.

title: Dense forests
description: Dense forests in Ghana are typically found in the southwest and east. You will usually see many naturally occurring palm trees, making the two regions recognizable.

title: Black pole markings
description: Black pole markings are most commonly seen in the southeast of the country, as well as some areas in the north.

title: Roads surrounded by tall and lush trees on both sides will generally place you in the north of the country.
description: Roads surrounded by tall and lush trees on both sides will generally place you in the north of the country. The more trees and the greener they are, the further north-northeast you should click.

title: Electricity poles with yellow markings are predominantly found in western and southern Poland.
description: Electricity poles with yellow markings are predominantly found in western and southern Poland.

title: Dry mountains and hills dominate much of the western and southern parts of the country.
description: Dry mountains and hills dominate much of the western and southern parts of the country.

title: All regular road generation 3 coverage in Ghana was made with a unique Google car.
description: All regular road generation 3 coverage in Ghana was made with a unique Google car. It has a visible roof rack with a piece of black tape on the right end of the front bar. In addition, the hood of the car is usually visible, showing a street view car wrapping that features a red rectangle and some other recognizable elements. Normally, this unique car is all you need to identify Ghana.

title: Ghana is mostly flat with red soil, however hills and mountains can be seen in some regions.
description: Ghana is mostly flat with red soil, however hills and mountains can be seen in some regions. Tropical vegetation is very common, and palms are common especially toward the south.

title: Taxis in Ghana typically have multicoloured body panels.
description: Taxis in Ghana typically have multicoloured body panels. The fenders and quarter panels are always coloured orange-yellow.

title: Road lines in Ghana are always white.
description: Road lines in Ghana are always white. However, many paved roads do not have road lines at all.

title: Generation 4 coverage in Ghana was taken using a grey or white pickup truck with an antenna in the front.
description: Generation 4 coverage in Ghana was taken using a grey or white pickup truck with an antenna in the front. The truck will be either fully or partially blurred most of the time.

title: Ghana uses white plates on normal vehicles, and yellow plates for commercial vehicles.
description: Ghana uses white plates on normal vehicles, and yellow plates for commercial vehicles. They can be long or short. Because commercial vehicles are really common, you will often see a mix of both plate colours.

title: Ghana typically uses wooden poles with 3 insulators on a metallic crossbar.
description: Ghana typically uses wooden poles with 3 insulators on a metallic crossbar.

title: Black and white
description: Black and white striped signposts in Ghana are typically seen in cities. On rural roads, you will mostly see classic, non-painted, metal signposts.

title: Ghana is a patriotic country, and you can often see things painted in the national flag’s colours: red, yellow, green, and sometimes including the black star.
description: Ghana is a patriotic country, and you can often see things painted in the national flag’s colours: red, yellow, green, and sometimes including the black star.

title: Street lamps mounted on top of the pole become more common towards the northeast of the country, with some pockets in the far south.
description: Street lamps mounted on top of the pole become more common towards the northeast of the country, with some pockets in the far south.

title: In contrast, lamps attached to the side of the pole are rarely found in the northeast.
description: In contrast, lamps attached to the side of the pole are rarely found in the northeast.

title: Many roads in Poland are lined by rows of trees.
description: Many roads in Poland are lined by rows of trees.

title: Polish chevrons are white with red arrows.
description: Polish chevrons are white with red arrows.

title: Poland has two town entry signs: a green one with the locality’s name, and a white-and-black one with a stylized urban area.
description: Poland has two town entry signs: a green one with the locality’s name, and a white-and-black one with a stylized urban area.
