title: Poland is one of the most Catholic countries in Europe.
description: Poland is one of the most Catholic countries in Europe. You can often find Christian shrines on the side of roads. Blue-white and yellow-white Polish Catholic flags also sometimes appear.

title: Neatly tiled sidewalks are very common in Poland.
description: Neatly tiled sidewalks are very common in Poland. Tiles are often grey or light red. Occasionally, even roads have tiled pavement. Many different types of tile patterns occur, including larger square tiles.

title: A white generation 4 Google car can also rarely be found in Poland.
description: A white generation 4 Google car can also rarely be found in Poland.

title: Warning signs are triangular and have a yellow background and a distinct thin red border.
description: Warning signs are triangular and have a yellow background and a distinct thin red border.

title: However, prohibitory signs are round and have a white background with a thicker red border.
description: However, prohibitory signs are round and have a white background with a thicker red border.

title: Regular Polish direction signs have a green background.
description: Regular Polish direction signs have a green background. These signs use a distinct font, which is a good clue for Poland.

title: Poland usually has thin concrete utility poles with see-through holes.
description: Poland usually has thin concrete utility poles with see-through holes. They are commonly known as “holey poles”. The holes often do not extend all the way to the bottom of the pole.

title: Poland is generally a flat country, with occasional rolling hills.
description: Poland is generally a flat country, with occasional rolling hills. The country is very green, with a lot of agriculture, and some amount of forest cover.

title: Poland has a unique pedestrian sign.
description: Poland has a unique pedestrian sign. Instead of the usual zebra stripes, it just has a single horizontal line.

title: Polish architecture
description: Polish architecture is fairly similar to other Central European countries. Buildings usually have plain stone walls covered in light or pastel stucco. Frequent roofing colours are orange or red, black, and brown. Roof tiles and panes often have a tidy, almost plastic-like look. Some rural houses have corrugated sheet roofs similar to those often found in the Baltics.

title: Poland has square (normal B-type) guardrails, with circular red reflectors.
description: Poland has square (normal B-type) guardrails, with circular red reflectors.

title: Poland has all-white road lines.
description: Poland has all-white road lines. Double middle lines are very common and usually a good clue for Poland.

title: A black generation 4 Google car can rarely be found in Poland.
description: A black generation 4 Google car can rarely be found in Poland.

title: Polish bollards have a red strip that wraps all the way around the bollard.
description: Polish bollards have a red strip that wraps all the way around the bollard. This strip has a red reflector on the front (sometimes hard to see), and a white reflector on the back. Bollards sometimes have numbers on them.

title: Poland has long white plates with the standard European blue strip on the left.
description: Poland has long white plates with the standard European blue strip on the left.

title: On a lot of the coverage you will see a grey Toyota SUV following the Street View car.
description: On a lot of the coverage you will see a grey Toyota SUV following the Street View car.

title: These repurposed vans can be found all over Kenya.
description: These repurposed vans can be found all over Kenya.

title: Directional signs are green with a white border and text.
description: Directional signs are green with a white border and text. They often display road numbers in white or yellow.

title: You will often see pole markings with a skull and a danger message on it.
description: You will often see pole markings with a skull and a danger message on it.

title: Kenya uses long white front licence plates.
description: Kenya uses long white front licence plates. The rear counterpart is square and yellow.

title: This mobile network brand named Safaricom is unique to Kenya, and almost every city has one location.
description: This mobile network brand named Safaricom is unique to Kenya, and almost every city has one location.

title: While infrequent, road signs in Kenya will mostly be red and white.
description: While infrequent, road signs in Kenya will mostly be red and white.

title: Outer lines in Kenya will always be solid white, while inner lines will be yellow and either solid or dashed.
description: Outer lines in Kenya will always be solid white, while inner lines will be yellow and either solid or dashed.

title: Kenyan poles are either made of concrete or wood, and have an L shaped crossbar.
description: Kenyan poles are either made of concrete or wood, and have an L shaped crossbar.

title: Kenya is mostly covered in Generation 4 pickup truck coverage.
description: Kenya is mostly covered in Generation 4 pickup truck coverage. Most trucks are blurred out, but sometimes you can see parts of the car, which can be many different colors, or a snorkel.

title: Many species of eucalyptus are commonly found in Kenya.
description: Many species of eucalyptus are commonly found in Kenya. They can be identified by their long, often clumped leaves, and smooth bark.

title: Generation 3 coverage in Kenya often features a visible roof rack and a snorkel.
description: Generation 3 coverage in Kenya often features a visible roof rack and a snorkel. Some Generation 3 coverage has no visible car.

title: Kenya has many unique Google cars in and around its National Parks and Reserves.
description: Kenya has many unique Google cars in and around its National Parks and Reserves. These are still identifiable by the snorkel which is present in almost all of them.

title: Some road signs have a blue background.
description: Some road signs have a blue background. This is an older style of sign that was used before signs with white backgrounds were introduced. They are relatively unique to Botswana.

title: Botswana has white front plates and yellow rear plates, similar to UK-style plates.
description: Botswana has white front plates and yellow rear plates, similar to UK-style plates.

title: Like the other countries in Southern Africa, outside road lines (if present) are yellow, while centre road lines are white.
description: Like the other countries in Southern Africa, outside road lines (if present) are yellow, while centre road lines are white.

title: The typical Botswana landscape is dry and mostly flat, though a limited amount of elevation can be found in certain regions.
description: The typical Botswana landscape is dry and mostly flat, though a limited amount of elevation can be found in certain regions. Common vegetation includes shrubs, small trees, and occasionally dry, golden grasslands. The soil is arid, sandy and ranges in colour from white to red.

title: Typical Botswana houses range from small impoverished shacks to comfortable middle-class bungalows.
description: Typical Botswana houses range from small impoverished shacks to comfortable middle-class bungalows. Some buildings have exposed grey bricks. On occasion, you might find traditional round huts.

title: Just like the other Southern African countries, direction signs have a green background.
description: Just like the other Southern African countries, direction signs have a green background.

title: These small red-and-white chevrons can sometimes be found next to the road.
description: These small red-and-white chevrons can sometimes be found next to the road.

title: Signs in Botswana are usually in English.
description: Signs in Botswana are usually in English. Most town names, however, are derived from any of the indigenous languages spoken in the country.

title: Random small blurs
description: Random small blurs are common in Botswana’s coverage. These blurs are similar to the ones found on licence plates and faces, but they cover seemingly random parts of the panorama instead. This is especially noticeable in urban areas, and mostly absent on more rural roads.

title: Curbs and guardrails are usually striped.
description: Curbs and guardrails are usually striped. Possible colour schemes are black-and-yellow, red-and-white, and black-and-white.

title: Botswana has a unique black-and-yellow striped signpost.
description: Botswana has a unique black-and-yellow striped signpost. More rarely, you can see red-and-white signposts.

title: All of Botswana was covered by a white Google car without an antenna.
description: All of Botswana was covered by a white Google car without an antenna.

title: Madagascar has two official languages: French and Malagasy, which is written with the Latin alphabet and contains many long, multiple-syllable words.
description: Madagascar has two official languages: French and Malagasy, which is written with the Latin alphabet and contains many long, multiple-syllable words.

title: Several boat trekkers can be found throughout the country.
description: Several boat trekkers can be found throughout the country.

title: All coverage in Madagascar was taken with a Generation 3 trekker camera.
description: All coverage in Madagascar was taken with a Generation 3 trekker camera.

title: The climate of Madagascar generally varies from extremely dry in the southern and central parts, to tropical in the north.
description: The climate of Madagascar generally varies from extremely dry in the southern and central parts, to tropical in the north.

title: Most coverage features one or several people walking alongside the trekker.
description: Most coverage features one or several people walking alongside the trekker. These people can be used both to recognise the country and to regionguess it.

title: Namibia uses green directional signs with the road number in yellow.
description: Namibia uses green directional signs with the road number in yellow.

title: Namibia drives on the left side of the road.
description: Namibia drives on the left side of the road.

title: Most roads in Namibia use single yellow outer lines and white centre lines.
description: Most roads in Namibia use single yellow outer lines and white centre lines.

title: You can spot these small stone bollards at intersections and on the sides of roads.
description: You can spot these small stone bollards at intersections and on the sides of roads.

title: Namibia primarily uses yellow front and back licence plates.
description: Namibia primarily uses yellow front and back licence plates. Vanity plates are white, with blue lettering.

title: Round metal bins, often painted green and white like the Nigerian flag, can be spotted at many rest stops and intersections.
description: Round metal bins, often painted green and white like the Nigerian flag, can be spotted at many rest stops and intersections.

title: All the coverage in Namibia was taken with a white pickup truck with a short antenna on the front.
description: All the coverage in Namibia was taken with a white pickup truck with a short antenna on the front. Notably, this antenna will always lean slightly to the left.

title: Namibia used to be a German colony, and as such, you can still notice the German influence, most notably in their place names.
description: Namibia used to be a German colony, and as such, you can still notice the German influence, most notably in their place names. Some older buildings can have a German style as well.

title: This map shows states with unique vehicle and tuk tuk colours.
description: This map shows states with unique vehicle and tuk tuk colours. If a vehicle is shown, the state will have yellow tuk tuks.

title: Within mainland Africa, Nigeria is currently the only country to have this low-quality coverage, known as official ari, or “shitcam”.
description: Within mainland Africa, Nigeria is currently the only country to have this low-quality coverage, known as official ari, or “shitcam”.

title: Nigeria uses short licence plates that appear somewhat green through the blur.
description: Nigeria uses short licence plates that appear somewhat green through the blur.

title: Roads are not always well-maintained in Nigeria, so roads without roadlines or faded roads are common.
description: Roads are not always well-maintained in Nigeria, so roads without roadlines or faded roads are common. Potholes, cracked roads and unpaved roads are also relatively common.

title: Most Nigerian houses are single-storey, with steeply pitched roofs commonly made of metal sheets.
description: Most Nigerian houses are single-storey, with steeply pitched roofs commonly made of metal sheets. Cinder block walls surrounding the houses are also common.

title: Nigeria is mainly Christian in the south, and Islamic in the north.
description: Nigeria is mainly Christian in the south, and Islamic in the north. As such, seeing women in hijabs and men in Muslim attire is more common in the north.

title: A visible Street View car is present in most of the coverage, being a pickup truck with the cab and bed visible.
description: A visible Street View car is present in most of the coverage, being a pickup truck with the cab and bed visible. The colour of the cab and other features of it varies. In Generation 3, a roof rack is present. You may also find a large blur covering the entire pickup truck.

title: City and state names
description: City and state names are often found on storefronts or banners in Nigeria, so knowing them can be quite useful.

title: Most Nigerian poles are made of concrete, have indents with a few horizontal supports, and are similar to the ones used in Brazil, but do not have holes through them.
description: Most Nigerian poles are made of concrete, have indents with a few horizontal supports, and are similar to the ones used in Brazil, but do not have holes through them.

title: A police car, most commonly white or black, can almost always be seen following the Street View car.
description: A police car, most commonly white or black, can almost always be seen following the Street View car. The follow cars may differ slightly from the ones shown in the image.
